meta.purpose: Secondary form hints and rule details at 12px.

shadows.name: floating-control
shadows.purpose: Prototype switcher, dialog, and transient feedback.

motion.name: view-enter
motion.purpose: A single restrained reveal when the review layout changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes nonessential animation and transition duration.

components.name: Primary Preview Button
components.description: Opens a confirmation preview for the selected safe-to-move files.
components.css: .ds-primary { height: 38px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--bark); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bark); color: var(--paper); font: 600 14px "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #6f4a31; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--bark); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary:active { background: #62432f; }

components.name: Secondary Scan Button
components.description: Runs a user-requested scan; secondary to reviewing selected files.
components.css: .ds-secondary { height: 38px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); font: 600 14px "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-secondary:hover { background: #f1f0e9; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--bark); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-secondary:active { background: var(--mist); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Filters file records by filename, rule, or destination.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #cccdbf; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--paper); color: var(--muted); font: 400 12px "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--bark); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Marks the current work area with a tonal surface rather than a side stripe.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--mist); color: var(--ink); font: 600 14px "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--paper); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-active strong { margin-left: auto; font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Ready Status
components.description: Shows a rule-matched file that is eligible for user preview.
components.css: .ds-status-ready { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 4px; background: #d8eee4; color: var(--mint-ink); font: 600 11px/1.4 "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Review Status
components.description: Marks conflicting rules that must not be moved automatically.
components.css: .ds-status-review { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 4px 7px; border-radius: 4px; background: #f1e8c9; color: var(--gold-ink); font: 600 11px/1.4 "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: This is a Windows-oriented workbench for reviewing files, rule matches, and destinations. It favors clear task state and recoverable actions over dashboard decoration. Color roles and shared controls are reusable; the three review layouts remain alternatives, not a selected production layout.
keyCharacteristics: Task-first hierarchy with a persistent navigation rail on wide screens.
Muted green surfaces balanced by bark-brown actions and distinct status colors.
Compact, fixed-size workhorse typography with legible labels.
Flat file rows and route groups; elevation is reserved for overlays and controls.

rules.name: The Status-Color Rule
rules.body: Color reinforces a written state label; it never carries the meaning alone.

rules.name: The Fixed-Ramp Rule
rules.body: Keep interface type sizes stable across widths; reflow layout instead of shrinking text.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: File rows and page sections stay flat; use tonal surfaces and dividers before adding elevation.

dos: Do show the filename, matching rule, destination, and state before any move.
Do pair every colored status with readable text.
Do keep the preview action visible in the task header and retain batch context below the review list.
Do use the shared palette roles consistently across all three prototype layouts.
donts: Don't imply that this UI prototype reads or moves real files.
Don't auto-move conflicts or files with no matching rule.
Don't rely on color alone for status, or use functional text smaller than 11px.
Don't add dashboard hero metrics, nested cards, or decorative gradients to the file-review surface.
